recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. A future request for universal maternal_family, paternal_family, cousin, or blood_relative concepts should be raised as a new PA/terminology request against the current personal-relationship terminology rather than applied under FHIR-10359.
issue_request: FHIR-10359 was Published with resolution Not Persuasive with Modification. It requested adding maternal_family, paternal_family, first_cousin, second_cousin, and blood_relative to the RelatedPerson relationship type value set for a family-history pregnancy use case, but the final resolution said the binding could be extended locally rather than adding core codes.
initial_application: No explicit git commit mentioning FHIR-10359 was found. The current RelatedPerson XML source was later imported with RelatedPerson.relationship using preferred binding strength, and the requested codes were not added to relatedperson-relationshiptype.
additional_context: RelatedPerson is active in source/fhir.ini. Later FHIR-15841 deliberately split RelatedPerson.relationship personal relationships from RelatedPerson.role functional roles: relationship now has a preferred binding to THO v3 PersonalRelationshipRoleType, while role has a preferred binding to relatedperson-relationshiptype. FHIR-31670 later expanded relatedperson-relationshiptype for functional-role concepts and is already represented on the combined branch. FamilyMemberHistory.relationship has example binding strength, and FamilyMemberHistory notes describe representing maternal family history assertions with Observations in a family-history List.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current preferred bindings are at least as permissive for local use-case-specific codes as the extensible binding cited by the Jira resolution, and adding maternal/paternal family concepts to the current functional-role value set would conflict with later source decisions.

related_jiras.note: Split personal relationships from functional roles for Patient.contact and RelatedPerson, moving RelatedPerson.relationship to THO v3 PersonalRelationshipRoleType with preferred binding.
Expanded relatedperson-relationshiptype for functional role concepts and is already represented on the combined branch.
Clarified RelatedPerson.relationship directionality before the later personal/functional split and is already represented on the combined branch.
